<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 100.0524. This matches the exact monoisotopic mass of C₅H₈O₂ (60 + 8·1.007825 + 2·15.994915 ≈ 100.0524). The isotopic pattern (≈5 % M+1) is consistent with a molecule containing five carbons. The formula C₅H₈O₂ gives an integer double‑bond equivalent (DBE = 2), so it is chemically plausible. Therefore the molecular formula is C5H8O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H8O2</final_answer>
